verification.environment: python 3.12 venv with fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pytest, jsonschema
verification.integration_scope: production memory FastAPI app served over real HTTP (uvicorn) with the real local governance authz evaluator, entries written through the real memory write routes; registry/research/pool/telemetry/search are HTTP fixtures

acceptance.1_schema_valid_four_groups_cited_items: test_trial_admission_for_the_persona_itself; every item has source_id, excerpt, retrieval_score, retrieval_mode
acceptance.2_facts_from_owner_apis_only: test_facts_come_from_owners_not_search; facts items are all source_owner != search

known_limits: The memory retrieve route does not yet report retrieval mode per hit; items record retrieval_mode=unreported until MEMORY-INDEX-PROJECTION lands, rather than guessing.
Owner base URLs and tokens come from fixed environment configuration (Owners.from_env); callers do not choose URLs.
Negative memory requires the institutional tag negative_memory plus a family:/underlying: subject tag; tag convention is owned by memory writers.

review_fixes.1_roles: Caller verified roles are always sent; committee visibility filtered client-side by relevance_scope; test_strict_auth_operator_token_gets_committee_memory (verified operator token, no http_403).
review_fixes.2_removed_history: versions[].members with stage=removed become bounded cited removed_member items; test_removed_member_history_and_no_invented_role.
review_fixes.3_negative_memory: Hits kept only if entry tags contain negative_memory AND a family:/underlying: subject tag; integration asserts only mem-2222 is labelled negative.
